title: C: Unit Testing with assert
description: Use assert.h to write simple unit tests for basic arithmetic functions.

steps.title: Test with assert
steps.description: Write functions `int add(int a, int b)` and `int multiply(int a, int b)`. Use `assert()` to test that add(2,3) == 5 and multiply(4,5) == 20. Print 'All tests passed!' after assertions.
hints: Use `printf("All tests passed!\n");` at the end.

verification.failureMessage: Run assertions and print success message
